reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The sink expression response.getWriter().print(bar) outputs user-controlled data directly to the HTTP response body. Tracing the data flow: request.getParameter(...) populates param, which is passed to doSomething(), where bar is assigned param.split(" ")[0]. This operation extracts the first word of the user input but does not sanitize HTML special characters (e.g., <, >, &), leaving potential XSS payloads intact. No HTML encoding is applied before printing bar to the response. Thus, the resolved sink value is attacker-controlled.
